summary: A bilateral UK–Taiwan collaboration under the Taiwan-UK University Consortium (TUKUC) that reframes net-zero logistics as a coordination problem, not just a technology one. Pairing the E3 Center at NTU with Newcastle University Business School, it builds an integrated renewable-energy–logistics–governance decision framework — coupling AI-driven optimization with structured human oversight to align intermittent solar and wind supply with time-sensitive freight operations under real infrastructure and policy constraints. Led by Prof. I-Yun Lisa Hsieh as the Taiwan-side PI.
summaryZh: 本計畫為臺英大學聯盟（TUKUC）架構下的雙邊合作，將淨零物流視為協調問題，而非單純的技術問題。由臺大 E3 中心與紐卡索大學商學院共同推動，建立整合「再生能源—物流—治理」的決策框架，結合人工智慧最佳化與制度化的人類監督，在真實的基礎設施與政策限制下，協調間歇性太陽光電與風電供給與時間敏感的貨運作業。由謝依芸副教授擔任臺灣端主持人。
metaDescription: A UK–Taiwan collaboration (TUKUC) building an AI-supported, human-governed decision framework that links intermittent renewable energy to time-sensitive net-zero logistics operations.
